question:
**Select the correct option:**

No sooner ____ the findings published than critics began questioning their legitimacy.
solution:
The correct answer is '**had**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• The phrase "**No sooner**" is always followed by the auxiliary verb in the past perfect tense, which in this case is "**had**." 
 
• When using "No sooner", the sentence structure typically follows an inversion pattern: "No sooner + auxiliary verb + subject + main verb."</l
